title: Supply and installation of LED Aviation Obstacle Light on Trestle Towers at Aguada & Surathkal DGPS Stations under Goa Directorate
summary: E-tender for supplying and installing red LED aviation obstacle lights, with underground cabling, on the DGNSS trestle towers at Aguada and Surathkal stations, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Aguada DGPS Station (DGNSS twin trestle tower)
sites.work: 2 LED aviation obstacle lights on twin trestle tower; 180 m UG cable supply, 110 m laying

sites.name: Surathkal DGPS Station (DGNSS single trestle tower)
sites.work: 1 LED aviation obstacle light on single trestle tower; 60 m UG cable supply, 25 m laying

scope.item: LED aviation obstacle lights, powder coated aluminium body, polycarbonate glass, IP65, 220 V AC, max 60 W, red, IS 16102, 12 months warranty (2 Aguada, 1 Surathkal, 2 spare)
3 core 2.5 sq mm XLPE copper armoured UG cable (180 m Aguada, 60 m Surathkal)
Laying of 1.1 kV PVC/XLPE power cable direct in ground incl. excavation, sand cushioning, protective covering, refilling (110 m Aguada, 25 m Surathkal)
Miscellaneous installation of aviation obstacle lights incl. cable laying on trestle towers, clamps, junction box, 10A DP MCB, base plate etc.

money.performance_security: 3% of contract value as FDR, valid three months after warranty period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. Tender fee Rs 500 (non-refundable) and EMD by DD/FDR in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa, payable at Goa, validity 90 days; originals by 16.12.2024 11:00. MSME bidders in eligible category may submit Bid Security Declaration (Form 9.6) instead of EMD. Penalty 1% per week, max 10%.

period.completion: 45 days from date of award of contract (GCC clause 4.8.1 says 30 days)
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of bid
period.warranty: 1 year from completion/acceptance, covering lightning and surge damage

eligibility: Registered electrical contractors or appropriate class contractors registered with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies
Similar work in last seven years: one work >= 80% (Rs 1,83,636), or two each >= 60% (Rs 1,37,727), or three each >= 40% (Rs 91,818) with Central/State Govt/PSU/private firm
Similar work: supply and installation of lights on trestle towers/high mast towers, underground cable laying of electrical works
Valid licence for all electrical works; PAN and GST; ITR for last three assessment years; CA-certified average turnover of last 3 years
Technical brochure, make and model of aviation LED light with compliance sheet; safety undertaking for working on high mast towers

Technical evaluation minimum 70/100 (statutory 35, financial 20, experience 10, performance 5, technical brochure/compliance 30); evaluation table experience thresholds Rs 5,40,000 / 4,05,000 / 2,70,000 in last three years
specs: LED aviation obstacle light: red, IP65, 220 V AC, max 60 W, powder coated aluminium body, polycarbonate glass, IS 16102
UG cable 3C x 2.5 sq mm XLPE copper armoured, ISI marked, Polycab/RR/Finolex or equivalent; conductor per IS 8130:2013; HV resistance test reports before supply
Trench 30-45 cm wide, 0.5 m deep with brick/terracotta tile protection and sand cushioning
Works per Goa State Electricity Board specifications or CPWD General Specifications for Electrical Works 2013 Part-I
